pages.title: About Homeo India — Our Mission for Indian Homeopathy
pages.description: Homeo India is an independent platform for academic learning, professional networking and knowledge sharing in homoeopathy. Read how verification works.
content: HomeoIndia is an independent platform created to facilitate academic learning, professional networking, educational discussions and knowledge sharing within the homoeopathic community.
HomeoIndia reviews the academic and professional information submitted by members. Registered-practitioner status is displayed only after checking applicable professional registration records.
HomeoIndia is not a government authority, statutory medical council, licensing body or medical registration authority.

pages.title: Who Can Join Homeo India — Homeopathic Doctors & BHMS Students
pages.description: Homeo India is open to registered practitioners, BHMS students, interns, qualified graduates and academic members aged 18+. See what each category needs.
content: Five membership categories: Registered Practitioner, BHMS Student, Intern, Qualified Graduate (registration pending) and Academic / Research Member.
Each category is verified differently. A degree does not by itself mean a person is registered to practise.

pages.title: Join Homeo India — Sign Up as a Homeopathic Doctor or Student
pages.description: Create your free Homeo India account and apply in the category that fits you: practitioner, student, intern, graduate or academic.
content: Choose your membership category — Registered Practitioner, BHMS Student, Intern, Qualified Graduate or Academic / Research Member — fill a short form and upload the proof it needs. A person reviews every application.
Membership is free and open to people aged 18 or over.

pages.title: Community Guidelines | Homeo India
pages.description: How to take part in Homeo India respectfully and safely, including clinical discussion rules, patient confidentiality and moderation.
content: Be respectful, honest about qualifications, and protect patient privacy.
Not allowed: harassment, impersonation, fake qualifications, fabricated research, copyright infringement, spam, patient-identifiable information and misleading clinical claims.
Moderators can remove content, warn, suspend or close accounts; members can appeal.

pages.title: Privacy Policy | Homeo India
pages.description: What personal data Homeo India collects, why, who processes it, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights.
content: Homeo India collects account details (name, email, photo), contact and location (mobile, city, state), academic and professional details, verification documents, the content members post, consent records and technical security logs.
Data is used for accounts, verification, community features, safety, support and legal obligations. It is not sold and there are no advertising or analytics trackers.
Processors: Supabase (database, sign-in, storage, sign-in emails), Vercel (hosting) and Google (optional Google sign-in, fonts).
Verification documents are private to the member and the verification team. Members can request access, correction, erasure, consent withdrawal or nomination from Edit Profile.

pages.title: Terms of Use | Homeo India
pages.description: The Terms of Use for Homeo India, an independent community for homoeopathic practitioners, students, interns, graduates and academics in India.
content: Homeo India is an independent platform, not a government authority, statutory council, licensing body or registration authority.
Members must be 18 or over and belong to one of five categories; students, interns, graduates and academics are never required to claim registration.
Clinical discussions are educational; patient-identifiable information is prohibited; Indian law governs the Terms.

pages.title: Sign In | Homeo India
pages.description: Sign in to Homeo India with your email or Google account.
content: Sign in to Homeo India with your email and password or with Google.

pages.title: Legal & Policies | Homeo India
pages.description: All Homeo India policies: privacy, terms, community guidelines, verification, copyright, clinical disclaimer, complaints and cookies.
content: Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Community Guidelines, Verification Policy, Copyright Policy, Clinical Discussion Disclaimer, Grievance & Complaint Policy and Cookie & Storage Policy, each with a version and effective date.

pages.title: Verification Policy | Homeo India
pages.description: How Homeo India verifies each membership category and what each badge means.
content: A verified degree is not a verified professional registration.
Only members whose registration has been checked against registration records receive the Verified Registered Practitioner badge.
Statuses: pending, additional information required, approved, rejected, registration lapsed or expired, re-verification.

pages.title: Copyright Policy | Homeo India
pages.description: What may be shared in the Homeo India Research Library and how to report copyright infringement.
content: Members may share citations, their own summaries, open-access full texts, texts shared with permission and their own work.
Copyright owners can send a takedown notice through the Contact & complaints form.

pages.title: Clinical Discussion Disclaimer | Homeo India
pages.description: Clinical discussions on Homeo India are educational only. No consultations and no emergency help.
content: Clinical discussions on Homeo India are for education between members and are not medical advice.
Homeo India is not a consultation service and gives no emergency help (call 112 in India).

pages.title: Grievance & Complaint Policy | Homeo India
pages.description: How to raise a complaint, privacy request, copyright notice or appeal with Homeo India.
content: Complaints, privacy requests, copyright notices and appeals are raised through the Contact & complaints form.
Each complaint is recorded, acknowledged, investigated and answered, with an appeal route.

pages.title: Cookie & Storage Policy | Homeo India
pages.description: Homeo India uses no tracking cookies — only the storage needed to keep you signed in.
content: Homeo India uses no advertising, tracking or analytics cookies.
Only browser storage needed to keep members signed in is used.

pages.title: Contact & Complaints | Homeo India
pages.description: Contact Homeo India about complaints, privacy, copyright or appeals.
content: Use the form for complaints, privacy questions, copyright takedown notices, verification disputes and appeals. Guests and members can both use it.

pages.title: Homeo India FAQ — Membership, Verification & Privacy
pages.description: Answers about Homeo India: who can join, verification, whether it is free, CME credits, clinical discussion rules, privacy and deleting your account.
